name: Display
description: Large display text for hero sections, marketing pages, and visual emphasis. Not a semantic heading — use Heading for document structure. Display is purely visual.

as.description: HTML element to render. Default: 'p'. Use Heading for semantic h1-h6.

do: Use Display for hero text, marketing headlines, and large visual emphasis
Pair with Heading when you need both visual size and semantic heading level
doNot: Do not use Display for document headings — use Heading for h1-h6 semantics
Do not use Display for body text — use Paragraph
